question.text: Surya Energy AIF (Cat I, 7-yr tenure): Set-up costs = INR 3 crore, PPM specifies amortisation over the FIRST 36 MONTHS (3 years) instead of full fund tenure. What is the annual set-up cost charged in each of Years 1, 2, and 3?

answer.text: INR 1.00 crore per year for 3 years (then zero)
INR 0.4286 crore per year for 7 years
INR 0.30 crore per year for 10 years

explanation.text: The Logic: Chapter 6 allows set-up costs to be amortised over the first 36 months or over the AIF's life. Electing the 36-month option here: INR 3 cr / 3 yr = INR 1 crore per year, charged in Years 1-3; zero thereafter. The Trap: B applies full-tenure amortisation (INR 3 / 7 = 0.4286), which would be valid only if the PPM elected the fund-life option; C expenses the full set-up in Year 1 with no amortisation; D uses a 10-year horizon that does not match either source-allowed period. Note: Set-up costs may be amortised over either the first 36 months or the full fund life — the PPM election decides. Always check the PPM before choosing a denominator.
